annotation.title_clean: Responsible Innovation: Israel's Policy on Artificial Intelligence Regulation and Ethics
annotation.title_en: Responsible Innovation: Israel's Policy on Artificial Intelligence Regulation and Ethics
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Israel Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology; Ministry of Justice (Office of Legal Counsel and Legislative Affairs)
named_instruments_referenced: Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: English summary of Israel's December 2023 AI regulation and ethics policy from the Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology. It names seven challenges: discrimination, human oversight, explainability, disclosure, safety, accountability and privacy. It recommends sectoral, risk-based, soft-law regulation in line with the OECD, an AI policy coordination centre, stakeholder forums, international engagement and a risk management tool.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adopt sector-specific regulation led by sectoral regulators rather than horizontal AI law
Use a risk-based approach and soft regulatory tools that allow the framework to develop step by step
Stay consistent with OECD AI Recommendations and leading countries' approaches
Establish an AI Policy Coordination Center, an inter-agency forum and a multistakeholder forum
Develop a government risk management tool to create a common terminology
